subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Fundy, Grand Manan
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Fundy, Grand Manan
Bio-collectors for scientific research will be deployed on the seabed at the following locations:
Black Point: 45° 12' 50.3892" N 066° 01' 15.1212" W and 45° 12' 33.0012" N 066° 00' 50.4612" W
Mispec Point: 45° 12' 25.4448" N 065° 59' 32.4132" W
Anthony's Cove: 45° 13' 55.8516" N 066° 00' 48.6504" W
Welch Cove: 45°05'15.9648"N 066°29'13.002"W
New River Island: 45° 07' 6.9672" N 066° 32' 50.0028" W
Beaver Harbor: 45° 04' 5.9664" N 066° 43' 9.0048" W
Deadman's Harbor: 45° 02' 45.9672" N 066° 47' 10.0032" W
 
Each bio-collector will be marked with a buoy.
